policy.denominator: Team defensive opportunities in games with a recorded player appearance, weighted by snaps; zero-defensive-snap special-teams appearances remain in the denominator.
policy.identityPolicy: Match player identity by validated identifiers; names/teamAtReview are review labels. Preserve the exception through a verified team change.
policy.unmatchedHandling: Unresolved snap identities remain flagged for review; do not assume zero or silently remove before deployment.
limitations: Counts are based on the reviewed snapshot; unresolved snap-source identities may change totals after reconciliation.
Approving this research policy does not modify live site assets or filters.
